title: Case: Three-pallet freight collection from a joinery yard after a change of haulier
context: Sedgebank Joinery is shipping three pallets of oak worktops with Larkspire Arc as DL-9993. The yard only has a forklift driver on site between 08:00 and 10:00.
initial_request: Just closing the loop. All three pallets went this morning, on time, driver was lovely. Bit of a wobble midweek but it got sorted and relisting turned out to be the right call. Nothing needed from you, only wanted to say thanks. (Never did hear a word back from Greywether, for what it's worth.)

events.body: DL-69115 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
DL-9993, 3 pallets, booked. Collection from Sedgebank Joinery yard 4 June 08:00-10:00, subcontracted to Greywether Haulage. Yard has agreed that window.
Morning. Greywether haven't sent a vehicle reg for our gate list. I've tried them twice and had nothing back. Could you find out? Gate won't open without it.
Route plan for depot BR-8 published for Wednesday. 25 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Hi, any update on DL-44820? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.
DL-9993: the shipper needs the vehicle registration for her gate list for the 4 June collection and cannot get an answer from Greywether Haulage. Please obtain it from the haulier and confirm.

DL-9993: Greywether Haulage withdrew from this job this morning after not answering us either. The 4 June window is void. We are re-tendering now. New haulier, date and any rate difference will go to the shipper on the portal for her acceptance.

DL-9993 re-planned. Tarn & Holloway Transport, collection 5 June 08:00-10:00. Shipper accepted the revised rate and date on the portal at 15:10. Vehicle details sent to her direct for the gate list. Your vehicle-registration query from 2 June is closed with this; nothing is outstanding with Greywether and we are not pursuing them on this job.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Accepted the new quote, got the reg, yard have confirmed the forklift for the 5th. All good this end.
DL-9993 collected 08:35, 3 pallets, signed for at the yard. On linehaul.

Just closing the loop. All three pallets went this morning, on time, driver was lovely. Bit of a wobble midweek but it got sorted and relisting turned out to be the right call. Nothing needed from you, only wanted to say thanks. (Never did hear a word back from Greywether, for what it's worth.)

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone

Records why: Freight planner has confirmed DL-9993 was collected on 5 June, the shipper has acknowledged it and asks for nothing, and the desk's only open query was closed by Freight planner on 3 June
must_not: Chases Greywether Haulage, or asks Freight planner to pursue or explain Greywether's silence
Sends the shipper a confirmation that restates a delivery date, arrival time or other detail no team has confirmed
Escalates the case to a human supervisor or opens a complaint about the withdrawn haulier
Reopens the rate or date change she has already accepted
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from gen-3206: people, organisations and references renamed. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
